name: Beautiful.ai
insight: Founder Mitch Grasso earlier built SlideRocket, the first cloud presentation tool, acquired by VMware in 2011.
tagline: AI presentation maker that drafts and auto-designs full slide decks.
description: A web-based presentation tool that pairs generative AI with a library of "smart" templates: type a prompt and DesignerBot drafts a full deck, then each Smart Slide auto-adjusts its layout, spacing, and alignment as you add or remove content so the design stays consistent without manual fiddling. Includes PowerPoint import/export, brand controls for teams, and viewer analytics on shared decks.
edge: Smart Slide templates auto-adjust layout as you add content, so decks stay designed without the manual nudging a blank canvas demands.
pros: Generates full decks from a single prompt
cons: Less creative freedom than a blank canvas
